lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 nodes, positioned posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a lattice-like arrangement across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots increasing in concentration toward the distal and posterior margins.
